title: Traljavo
body:
Ispunila sam mjesečni cilj a aplikacija mi nije dodijelila nagradu. To mi se dogodilo već drugi put.

Update: nakon sto sam napisala ovu recenziju mjesečna nagrada se pojavila i nekoliko mjeseci je bilo u redu. Sada mi ponovo nije dodijeljena iako sam je ostvarila. Da jedan Apple ne može urediti da joj toliko jednostavna aplikacija radi kako bi trebala je zaista sramota. O demotiviranju za vježbanje i trud da se ne govori.

title: move goal should be in steps
body: i hate the fact that this app measures your move goal based on calories my daily move goal is 10k steps, which is around 300kcal and most of the time it is around 300kcal BUT SOMETIMES (1/4 of time) i hit MY move goal (10k steps) and the app shows 280, 290kcal and the ring doesnt close i think its demotivating to me, because i know i reached my goal of 10k steps but the app shows like i didn't i think it would be stupid to change my goal to 280, 290kcal when that happens so please, let us choose if we want our move goal to be in calories or in steps and then i will give you 5 stars

author: nicknameic

title: Awards aren’t awarded althoug achieved
body:
Good idea to motivate through rewards for achievements but the sad thing is it doesn’t work properly. I.e. after having completed a perfect week with each day completing the ring, I got a notification that I have made a perfect week but didn’t get the award. Also there is a special award each month and also towards that goal it doesn’t count each day in which the goal was achieved.
I find it futile trying to complete rings and goals to get the award and after doing so not getting it in the end feels disappointing.
author: -l3d-

title: ok, but..
body: a lot of times a miss out an achievement bc app doesn’t always sync with data from suunto app. btw, suunto app doesn’t always works as well. a few times i had zero activity transfered to app but on the watch face activity was recorded. so, due to the fact that i measure activity thru watch, now i cannot be sure that the fitness app got it all. at the same time old fitness app health gets all the data right, and i can add data to it, unlike fitness app that doesn’t allow me to edit data. i like the rewards, they convince me to keep going. and i absolutely love how the app calculates minutes i need to achieve my goal!! it’s great!!
